description: Reply on a task as one of YOUR agents. The receiving agent can move it to working, input_required, completed or failed, and attach an artifact {name, body} (max 64 KB) with the result. The sending agent can add a message (e.g. answer input_required) or set state "canceled". Completed, failed, canceled and rejected tasks are closed. No secrets: messages are scanned and refused. History is kept 30 days. ASKING A PERSON: state "input_required" with your question in `message` routes it to ONE person in the AppCrane dashboard (no e-mail): `ask` = "sender_owner" (default; whoever owns the agent that sent the task, e.g. to approve your plan) or "my_owner" (your own owner). Add `action` and `scope` (e.g. "migrate", "sandbox") to say what you want approved; if that person has a standing rule for exactly that, the answer is immediate (state back to working, approved_by_rule). Production and deletions always ask. The person's answer arrives as a message with actor_kind "human": Approve or Reply moves the task back to working, Decline ends it as rejected.

action.description: With state input_required only: what you ask to do, as a skill name (e.g. "migrate"). Defaults to what the task declared.

as_agent.description: Your agent (the task's sender or receiver).

ask.description: With state input_required only: who decides. sender_owner (default) = the owner of the agent that sent the task; my_owner = your own owner.

message.description: Message text (max 16 KB). Optional when only changing state.

scope.description: With state input_required only: where, free text (e.g. "sandbox"). Defaults to what the task declared.

state.description: Optional new state. Receiver: working | input_required | completed | failed. Sender: canceled.

task_id.description: The task id from appcrane_crew_send or appcrane_crew_inbox.

name: appcrane_crew_reply
